question: The headquarters of Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIL) is situated in _______ .
solution:
The correct answer is " **Mysuru** ".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Central Institute of Indian Languages is an **Indian research **and** teaching Institute** situated in **Mysuru**.
 
• It was founded on** 17 July 1969.**
 
• It is the part of **language bureau** of the **Ministry of Human Resource development**.
 
• The aim of the institute is to **protect and document minor, minority and tribal languages.**
